name: @postman-cse/deloitte-workspace-access
description: Onboard every detected GitHub collaborator into Postman and render Deloitte usage notifications.

scripts.bundle: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --outfile=dist/cli.cjs && node -e "if(process.platform!=='win32')require('node:fs').chmodSync('dist/cli.cjs',0o755)"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:cli && npm run test:e2e:action && npm run test:e2e:init && npm run test:e2e:package && npm run test:e2e:release
scripts.qa: npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:vendor && npm pack --dry-run
